summary: Stripe billing repository controls and focused tests are present, but checkout, portal, signed webhook delivery, ledger persistence, subscription mutation and stale-claim recovery have not been executed against the configured target runtime for the final release commit.

repositoryValidation.scope: source contracts and focused automated tests only
controlsObserved: Billing mutations require authenticated organization billing authority, step-up and trusted origin

Stripe webhook events use a durable idempotency ledger before subscription mutation
Replay-safe stale processing claims have a bounded atomic recovery design
Subscription sync validates organization, customer and server-side plan binding

completionRule: Run a reviewed test-mode Stripe validation against the target deployment and database for the exact promoted commit, attach sanitized workflow and artifact provenance, and verify checkout, portal, signed webhook delivery, ledger persistence, subscription mutation, duplicate suppression and stale-claim recovery before changing status to Complete.
releaseGate: Blocked: Stripe billing runtime validation has not been executed for the target environment and exact release commit.
